spec_basis.STU-VEC-003: dragging a straight segment MUST convert it to a curve by synthesizing handles on its endpoints without destroying adjacent geometry (bend_segment)
spec_basis.STU-VEC-109: handle_mirroring.none NONE / angle ANGLE / angle_and_length ANGLE_AND_LENGTH; point type smooth = 1, corner = 2 is a DERIVED read-only projection

spec_basis.STU-VEC-043: Studio MUST provide a reverse-direction command
spec_basis.STU-VEC-048: scissors splits a path at a parametric point on a segment into two open endpoints sharing a coincident position
spec_basis.STU-VEC-133: path index out of bounds; point index out of bounds; cannot join path points ... Each MUST be individually distinguishable by a model from its typed error code
